newsitem.title: USA: Cree Research, Siemens sign $5 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Cree Research, Siemens sign $5 mln deal.

text.p: Cree Research Inc said Thursday it had signed a contract with Siemens AG to supply Siemens with more than $5 million worth of LED chips.
Cree said the contract was the largest it had ever signed.
It said it would supply Siemens with gallium nitride on silicon carbide LED chips through fiscal 1997. Siemens is to use the LEDs for high volume LED applications, it added.
Cree said its research team would join the one at Siemens to try to improve voltage and develop a conductive buffer layer.
The blue LED chips are silicon carbide-based semiconductors used in optoelectronic, power, high temperature, radio-frequency and other memory applications.
